data.body: Held-out TDD result: standard-tier gpt-5.6-terra implementer passed the 2 visible happy paths in one initial attempt. Restored 4 hidden cases; cycle 1 exposed a real rooted-built-in regression (repo-aware set replaced base/verify/overlays). Same-tier corrective dispatch fixed the union in one attempt. Full oracle then passed 6/6. Defect-seeded mutation changed rooted classification to the wrong condition and made the hidden logical-id/path EvalError test RED; restoration returned 6/6 GREEN. Refactoring litmus passes: assertions target mapping/dispatch return values, runner calls, and located error text, not source layout or local names.
